input: Any UX interview transcript or participant narrative; no named-person preset.

knowledgeGroups.billing: Billing, billing accounts and budgets terminology
knowledgeGroups.scope: Projects, time range, services, credits, read-only, savings and labels terminology
knowledgeGroups.budget: Fixed amount, last-month spend, alert-only versus spend-cap terminology
knowledgeGroups.alerts: Thresholds, actual versus forecast spend, Pub/Sub, monitoring, recipient roles terminology
knowledgeGroups.concepts: Cloud billing account/project relationships, budget scope defaults, alerts versus caps, recipient eligibility

output: Summary, supported field proposals with source quotes, and unresolved fields. Final card is a sue-persona v3 card: traits and states as 0-10 scores.

humanFactors.title: Vision / text clarity
humanFactors.help: Ability to read small or low-contrast text. Scenario setting, not a clinical assessment.

humanFactors.title: Color discrimination
humanFactors.help: Keep color cues separate from text clarity.

humanFactors.title: Click precision
humanFactors.help: Intended to distinguish motor slips from misunderstanding a control.

humanFactors.title: Reading speed
humanFactors.help: Reading pace, separate from hesitation, English proficiency and patience.

humanFactors.title: Attention to warnings
humanFactors.help: How readily warnings attract attention, independently of general detail.

humanFactors.title: Primary personal priority
humanFactors.help: What this person prioritizes when competing information appears.

humanFactors.title: Financial risk judgment
humanFactors.help: Ability to recognize financial consequences; not willingness to click unfamiliar controls.

humanFactors.title: Financial caution
humanFactors.help: Willingness to accept financial exposure, separately from recognizing the risk.

humanFactors.title: Task stress tolerance
humanFactors.help: How readily setbacks affect this person, separate from the static deadline setting.

humanFactors.title: Pressure over the task
humanFactors.help: Desired pressure pattern. The current engine has no dynamic pressure model.
